contradictions_or_unknowns: SCHEMA:CanonicalState references $defs types (e.g. ActiveTask, GateState, Authority) whose full enum schemas are declared externally, but field-level semantics are fully consistent.
invariants_to_preserve: Gemini proposals are untrusted proposals and never directly write canonical state or assign execution projections.
Lenses, History, and What-If operations remain strictly read-only and zero-write.
Raw uploaded artifacts and unconfirmed typed inputs are never persisted to CanonicalState.
Execution status (ACTIVE / PARALYZED / COMPLETE) is strictly deterministically derived.
next_three_actions: Verify Firestore transaction handlers enforce expected_version equality against MutationEvent.
Add unit tests for HMAC token generation and verification during WhatIfBranch promotion.
Validate gate state resolution logic ensures stale facts never trigger PARALYZED execution state.
review.overall_assessment: The architecture cleanly separates human authority from ephemeral exploration and autonomous execution projections. Epistemic state, execution state, and deterministic temporal invalidation are well-bounded, with solid optimistic concurrency controls and tight budget limits.

recommendations.implementation_tip: In the profile update transaction, verify profile_doc.get('version') == mutation.expected_version before writing and increment version by exactly 1.
recommendations.observation: SCHEMA:MutationEvent specifies expected_version and result_version, while CanonicalState carries version. Concurrent updates must assert expected_version == CanonicalState.version within the transactional boundary.
recommendations.title: Validate MutationEvent expected_version atomically in Firestore transaction
recommendations.validation: Execute two concurrent mutation requests with expected_version=0; verify exactly one succeeds with version=1 and the other fails with a concurrency conflict.
recommendations.why_it_matters: Prevents lost updates or branch race conditions when multiple client tabs or revalidations submit mutations concurrently.

recommendations.implementation_tip: Implement a constant-time HMAC check over (profile_id, source_version, id, sha256(hypothetical_summary)) before allowing branch promotion.
recommendations.observation: What-If branches return a profile-bound HMAC token without persisting to Firestore. Promotion must verify the HMAC token, expiry, and match source_version against current canonical version.
recommendations.title: Enforce HMAC signature and source version validation on WhatIfBranch promotion
recommendations.validation: Submit a modified WhatIfBranch payload with an invalid or expired token; verify the promotion endpoint returns a 403/400 validation error without writing to Firestore.
recommendations.why_it_matters: Ensures ephemeral hypothetical states cannot be tampered with in the client or applied against stale canonical states.

recommendations.implementation_tip: In the gate evaluation function, check Fact.status; if status == 'stale', downgrade gate state from CONFLICTED to BLOCKED/PENDING_EVIDENCE prior to execution status derivation.
recommendations.observation: The contract dictates that stale facts cannot ground CONFLICTED or PARALYZED execution states.
recommendations.title: Ensure stale facts clear conflicted gate states deterministically
recommendations.validation: Mark a foundational fact as stale; assert that dependent gates clear CONFLICTED state and execution projection does not evaluate to PARALYZED.
recommendations.why_it_matters: A gate depending on an expired or stale fact could otherwise falsely lock the plan in PARALYZED.

rejected_or_deferred_ideas: Do not implement dynamic LLM-based dependency detection or probabilistic freshness scores.
Do not add multi-document distributed transaction schemes; maintain one compact canonical profile document.
Do not weaken human gate confirmation on non-artifact typed inputs.
strongest_patterns: Unidirectional governed promotion: exploration (What-If/Fog Bank) and inspection (Lenses/History) are strictly zero-write and ephemeral.
Deterministic execution projection (ACTIVE, PARALYZED, COMPLETE) strictly derived by controller logic without LLM assignment.
Static temporal dependency graph with field-level receipt patches that avoids LLM orchestrators or percentage freshness scoring.
